t4752:
Summer means shaved ice and watermelon smashing...
I was looking forward to all of it, but nobody said we'd be stuck in the mountains with no shops, nya!
...Fine. I'll find a huuuge bug and show it off to Chloe, nya!
t4753:
Lazing around from morning till night...
I'm gonna enjoy a super-classy vacation, nya!
t4754:
That was fun, nya...
Nyafufu.
Next up, it's time for "Great Detective Lady Anya," nya!!
t4755:
It's nice to visit a place like this once in a while.
The outfits, however, I do have some objections to.
Syr said it was only natural, but walking around dressed like this...
t4756:
Syr all but dragged me here.
Honestly... she always has me at her beck and call.
t4757:
The one who deserves the most credit for this event... Andromeda, perhaps?
This time included, the hardships of always being at Lord Hermes's side must be immeasurable.
The next time she visits The Benevolent Mistress, I'll treat her to something.
t4758:
A classy vacation with everyone is just wonderful!
It's a shame Lunoire and Mama Mia couldn't come, though.
t4759:
I even talked Ryu into wearing a swimsuit.
Summer by the water means swimsuits. It just doesn't start without them!
t4760:
Lord Hermes's plan this time is so much fun!
Tee-hee... I wonder if Bell will be surprised?
I can't wait!
t4762:
My idiot brothers and Allen's lot are all so quick to brawl...
You have no idea how much trouble it is
playing peacemaker all the time... *sigh*
t4763:
We are...
Lady Freya's "possessions," now and forever.
Whatever her "wish" may be, we will grant it.
t4764:
Our "infinite coordination" needs no words... not even a glance.
It's perfect, flawless telepathy. Trouble is, that makes it hard to keep secrets... Such a pain...
t4766:
Guarding the "girl" again today, huh?
Don't go stirring up trouble...
t4767:
As Vana Freya, I'll carry out her every wish, whatever it may be.
But... she's far too whimsical. She's been given a little too much freedom.
t4768: Damn it. Can't that "dimwit" just stay put in her tavern?
t4770:
"Remodeling" that foolish rabbit gave me no end of trouble...
but he's taken on the bare minimum of shape.
Such is the burden of a dim-witted pupil.
t4772:
Every tactic, every scrap of information,
foe and ally alike, even my own life...
I shall use every piece on the board to achieve my goal.
t4774:
Eek?! S-someone's looking...
Um... uh... stop...
P-please don't stare at me like that...
t4775:
I-I am the jet-black knight, born of the cursed abyss!
If it is the goddess's wish,
I shall curse all and destroy all.
t4776:
The white rabbit, offering to the goddess...
His will never falters, no matter the adversity.
I... don't dislike him. Not at all.
t4778:
The sword of black supremacy, named with Her prayers—
I shall wield it now, upon an "oath" sworn with my very life.
t4779: It is precisely because the goddess chose that soul that weakness cannot be permitted.
t4780: This officers' meeting... will turn into an argument as well, no doubt.
t4782:
Welcome, dear customer~♪
Have a blast at the casino with me, the Goddess of Luck!
t4783:
Mm-hmm... As expected of me!
I pull off the bunny look perfectly!
If I hop out in front of Bell like this... ehehe~...
t4784:
Uheheh... Bell... hop, hop...
Ah, it's too soon! Hold it in, me...!
t4786:
For a "bunny girl," the casino is the main battlefield.
When in Rome, do as the Romans do.
Welcome, dear customer.
t4787:
When she spoke of "the ultimate way to earn money," I never imagined it meant an outfit like this...
Still, beggars can't be choosers.
I must be grateful to Lady Hestia... kuh...
t4788:
I wonder if the children at the shrine are doing well...
...Surely they'd never imagine me at a casino in such a shameless getup.
t4789:
Justice goes around—it stays connected.
Alise, Kaguya, Lyra... they all live on inside me, even now.
t4792:
New Year's... Far Eastern food.
It's all delicious. Ozoni, osechi...
And... the New Year's special flavor Jyaga Maru-kun.
t4793:
Putting on the formal kimono was really hard...
The Far Eastern people who wear these all the time
are amazing...
t4794:
I hope this year will be... a happy one,
a good year... for everyone.
t4795:
The "New Year's Lucky Maiden Contest"...
I absolutely can't lose.
I need to train and get even faster...
t4796:
I'll go out with Ms. Ais in my furisode just like this...
We'll walk all around Orario and split a single Jyaga Maru-kun between the two of us.
Ehehe.
t4797:
Huh?!
I sense that shameless, perverted human...
I-is it just my imagination...?
t4798:
Bell... I love you.
These feelings... surely they'll never change, no matter how much time passes.
t4799:
I'll accept your insults. Scorn me all you like.
But... I will not apologize.
t4800:
The lost kitten. The lonely black cat. The girl seeking a place to belong. The fairy striving to be sincere...
They're all my favorites. Yes. And yet, I...
t4803: I wonder what Orion is thinking right now.
t4804:
Chairwoman of the Committee to Eradicate Impure Relations... is it?
Remembering the person I used to be...
gives me mixed feelings.
t4805:
The "grave sin" I committed must never be forgiven.
And to atone for it, I dragged so many others into it...
t4806:
Trips where you go with the flow are nice too...
but this trip with Artemis can't be like that. Absolutely not.
Whatever anyone thinks of me, I'm setting the stage.
t4807:
Once I'm back... Asfi's going to chew me out something fierce.
And when that time comes, she'll cry and...
*sigh* I don't want to see that face.
t4808:
No need for a gloomy face.
After all, I'm "Hermes."
t4810:
I wonder if Riveria... would become a magical girl too?
I think I'd... like to try it with her.
t4811:
A magical girl is all about landing her finishing move gracefully.
Loki told me that...
"Lovely Smile—Magical Sunrise!"
Is this... how it goes?
t4812:
Tiona...
You know so much about hero stories. That's amazing.
t4814:
"I'll cast a smile spell on you☆!
Magical Change, Sunny Smile!!"
...Yup! Nailed it, nailed it!
t4815:
I want lots and lots more people
to know about magical girls... Maybe I'll try
helping people out dressed as a magical girl!
t4816:
That "Sunday morning" place Loki talked about...
I wonder if they've got other exciting stuff
besides magical girls.
t4817: ...Maybe I should polish it a little more?
t4818: No dirt, no scratches... Mm, looking good.
t4819:
I need to take it to Lord Goibniu before it gets damaged.
...He'll scold me again.
t4820:
......Hmph.
This sword fits me best, but...
I'd like a backup weapon, too.
t4822:
Something's missing from the flavor...?
A bit more vinegar, sugar, honey, and salt should do it...
Oh, I think the kitchen had Far Eastern and foreign seasonings too... I'll put them all in♪
t4823:
Is it about done simmering?
Heh-heh, I have a feeling it'll turn out great this time.
I'll have to get Anya and Ryu to taste it♪
t4824:
What should I make for Bell's lunch tomorrow?
Maybe I'll try a new dish?
Heh-heh, I hope Bell likes it♪
